resources.string: Lets the IRIDIS GUI agent see the screen (screenshots and UI elements) and tap, swipe and type for you when you start a task. It acts only while a task runs and the floating bar can stop it anytime; it asks first before paying, sending or deleting. The screen is processed only by on-device models and never uploaded.
